title: CORRECTION to this session's own earlier misdiagnosis: the 'severe DB/resource contention' blocking migration-guard test + reconciliation-script verification was actually npx's own resolution layer, not the DB or the tools themselves
root_cause: Isolated precisely by bisection: a trivial one-line script hung 20s+ under 'npx tsx' with zero output (not even the script's own first line), but ran in 1.8s via the local ./node_modules/.bin/tsx binary directly. Same pattern confirmed for vitest (./node_modules/.bin/vitest ran the full migration-manifest-guard suite - 9/9 passing - in 3.8s total, vs. repeated 90s+ hangs via npx vitest). A raw mysql2 connection (no tsx/npx involved) had already responded in 255ms earlier in this same pass, which should have been the tell that DB itself was fine and something in the npx invocation path was the actual bottleneck - concluding 'DB/resource contention' from that evidence was premature and is corrected here.
evidence: Direct timed bisection: npx tsx (20s+ timeout, zero output) vs ./node_modules/.bin/tsx (1.8s, correct output) on an identical trivial script; npx vitest (repeated 90-120s hangs) vs ./node_modules/.bin/vitest (3.8s, 9/9 tests passing) on the identical migration-manifest-guard.test.ts.
